title: DomainTask v2
description: Adapter-layer exchange type: the normalized result of one domain task — domain label, the adapter schema version the domain payload conforms to, the validated domain payload, and the mapped research-task/v1 draft. v2 extends only the domain vocabulary (ADR-0008 L2 addendum: the ADR-0008 decision 2 escape hatch fired when the ML adapter discovered the v1 two-domain freeze); v1 remains frozen and live for the math/quant producers. Seam exchange types are translation contracts, not store facts: they never enter the core family registry and can never be published to a core store.

domain.description: Domain label of the producing adapter. Frozen to the three v2 domains; a fourth domain requires a new adapter schema version (ADR-0005 decision 10).

domain_schema_id.description: Schema id (for example ml-task/v1) of the domain input schema the payload conforms to. The owning adapter validates domain_payload against it; the seam layer only pins the versioned reference.

domain_payload.description: Validated domain input. Deliberately unconstrained here: the domain shape is owned by the referenced domain schema, never by the seam layer.

core_task_draft.description: Mapped research-task/v1 payload draft. Only the schema tag is pinned here; full validation happens when a caller loads or publishes the draft through the core API.
